items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: But I got some great advice from Tartarella from the Boston Conservatory of Music when I was in the Navy.

ctx.x: Helping you with the clarinet. But I got some great advice from Tartarella from the Boston Conservatory of Music when I was in the Navy. Yes. And I would practice and he'd sit down and tell me the different things and he'd see to it that I would smooth out my tones and so forth. It made quite a great difference in my playing.
I was wondering about Teo since he's not living of course and we never found very much information about Teo. Do you remember much about how he played and what he told you when he helped you or what
